$comment: Third difficulty pass, and the first one to measure this route against the player who actually files the reports rather than a middle-of-the-road average. Experience is split between everything that takes the field, so a player raising four kin arrives here at NINE, not the eleven a solo lead reaches; measured at nine, the old 6-10 band won only 64/61/83 percent of average rolls and 56/48/59 percent at the top of the band. The top of the band was doing nearly all of the damage. Every slot is now 5-7, so the worst roll on the route is two levels UNDER the arriving player instead of one over. Weight also moves onto the two neutral Beast slots and off the Stone and Terra ones: a Stone attack is STAB on a Chalkid or a Slatewing and doubles into Flame, which is why the Cinderpaw player specifically was losing half of this route.
